plan_metadata.name: Sample Resource specific consent with Graph API in Group Chat

steps.description: Click the "Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit" workspace item in the Explorer panel within the Visual Studio Code interface.
Click the "View Samples" button in the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit sidebar.
Click on the search bar in the "Samples" section of the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit interface to input or filter items.

parameters.text: Resource specific consent with Graph API

steps.description: Type text into the search input field labeled 'Search' within the 'Samples' tab of the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit interface: 'Resource specific consent with Graph API'.
Click on the "Graph RSC Helper" sample card in the "Samples" section of the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit interface.
Click the "Create" button in the "Graph RSC Helper" interface within the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit application.
Click on the "Default folder" text box located within the "Workspace Folder" dialog to select or input a folder path for the project.
@assertion 'Preview README.MD' is visible
@assertion the page title contains 'Resource specific consent with Graph API'
Right-click on the "Preview README.md" tab in the Visual Studio Code application interface to interact with the preview pane displaying documentation for the Stocks Update Notification Bot project.
Click the "Close" option in the context menu within Visual Studio Code to close the currently open tab, specifically the "Preview README.md" tab.

parameters.sample:
=== Generated Script ===
Language: bash

```bash
#!/bin/bash

# Define file path
file_path="/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects/stocks-update-notification-bot/env/.env.local"

# Verify file exists
if [ -f "$file_path" ]; then
    # Perform the replacement
    sed -i 's|TEAMSFX_API_ALPHAVANTAGE_ENDPOINT=|TEAMSFX_API_ALPHAVANTAGE_ENDPOINT=https://www.alphavantage.co|' "$file_path"
    echo "Replacement done successfully."
else
    echo "File does not exist: $file_path"
    exit 1
fi
```
